nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 26 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 43 MHz; phase margin of at least 70 degrees; 1% settling time for the large step of at most 33 ns; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1.
